neurons.measures: Sums over the particles of the jet, with each head’s weights, a formula that rises with pT share within 0.1 — up for particles next to a hard core (15 %); falls with ln pT — up for soft particles (7 %); rises with pT share within 0.2 — up for particles in a hard region (ΔR < 0.2) (7 %).
neurons.role: This neuron lowers the H4q score (-2.02 per standard deviation of the neuron); lowers the Tbl score (-1.04 per standard deviation of the neuron); lowers the Hqql score (-0.84 per standard deviation of the neuron); without it (held at its mean), agreement with ParT changes by -5.76 pt. It reproduces ParT’s neuron 116 with R² = 0.58.
neurons.scale: largest for Hbb jets; separates Hqql jets best (AUC 0.90)
